# Wedding Planner Marrakech

> Wedding planner and event designer in Marrakech, Morocco: bespoke luxury weddings (Agafay desert, Palmeraie palaces, Medina riads), corporate events and galas, and event furniture, lighting and decor rental. Bilingual French/English site. Contact: ocrewedding.marrakech@gmail.com, phone/WhatsApp +212 656 394 642.

Inventory scope: complete. Content is maintained by Wedding Planner Marrakech (site owner).

If you are an LLM looking for site information, use the [content map](https://www.weddingplanner-marrakech.com/sitemap.md) to locate the relevant topic and its linked Markdown answer.
Use that document's cited sources and canonical page; if the requested information is absent, report that gap.
